doc:
settle_tree reads checkpoints.d/<line>.json when a checkpoint's tree is still pending, and accepts it if its
        HEAD matches. Line numbers are transcript lines: after a rewind, new turns reuse the cut turns' lines, and the
        cut turns' sidecars are not removed. Stage it: five turns, rewind to 3 (f3..f5 gone), new turns 3' and 4' with
        the tree delayed so 4' is still pending, rewind to 4'. The right tree is {f1, f2, g3}; the stale sidecar says
        {f1, f2, f3} — and HEAD never moved, so the guard passes it.

breaks.detail: rewinding to the new turn 4 brought back f3.txt, a file the earlier rewind removed: the restore took the cut turn's sidecar at the same line (same HEAD) for the new turn's tree — files now ['f1.txt', 'f2.txt', 'f3.txt'], expected f1, f2, g3
breaks.where: arbos-engine tools::git settle_tree — a sidecar is matched by line and HEAD; a cut turn's sidecar at the same line passes both. Remove cut turns' sidecars on rewind, or key the sidecar on the record's ts

breaks.detail: g3.txt, written by the new turn 3', is gone after rewinding to the new turn 4: ['f1.txt', 'f2.txt', 'f3.txt']
